components.name: dialog
components.note: Single component: title, description and closeLabel replace the Dialog parts, and there is no trigger part (the caller owns open state). The close button carries the states. `modal` (default true) presents a host Modal. `modal={false}` draws the dialog in place over a live page, with no veil: Android back and the accessibility escape gesture still close it, and screen-reader focus moves to the title. `overlay` is "scrim" (default, as on web) or "none". The scrim is a decorative veil in the background colour at 0.8 opacity that takes no touches, so a modal Dialog now dims the page unless it passes overlay="none".

components.name: drawer
components.note: Single component like Dialog: the caller owns open state, and the close button carries the states. Edge modal with `direction`, `snapPoints` (fractions of the window or "<n>px"; invalid entries are ignored, the rest sort smallest first and the drawer opens on the smallest), `activeSnapPoint` and `setActiveSnapPoint`, `snapToSequentialPoint`, `closeThreshold`, `dismissible`, `handleOnly`, `autoFocus`, `modal`, `onClose`, `onDrag`, `onRelease` and `onAnimationEnd`. Dragging uses the core PanResponder: a release flung faster than 0.4 pt/ms goes to the furthest snap point (the next one with snapToSequentialPoint), a slower drag settles on the nearest, and a dismissible drawer closes once the drag covers closeThreshold of its lowest snap point. A swipe-dismiss reports onRequestClose("requestClose"). With more than one snap point the handle is an adjustable control (increment and decrement actions, press to cycle) so snapping has a single-pointer alternative; its value reads as the percentage of the window shown. `dismissible={false}` blocks back, escape and drag-to-close but keeps the close button and snapping. Reduced motion snaps without animation. onAnimationEnd(open) fires after a snap or drag settles, not after the open and close presentation of the host Modal. No native meaning, so not offered: fadeFromIndex (there is no backdrop fade tied to a snap), nested (a nested drawer is a second Drawer) and fixed (no keyboard-driven repositioning of a fixed drawer). Web-DOM props not listed: container, noBodyStyles, scrollLockTimeout, disablePreventScroll, preventScrollRestoration, repositionInputs, shouldScaleBackground, setBackgroundColorOnScale.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.note: Modal list with one selected item (selectedId), as groups of actions, checkboxes, radio groups and sub-menus. No separators, labels or shortcuts as parts. `anchorRef` places the list against an element (the native counterpart of DropdownMenuTrigger): `side`, `align`, `sideOffset` (default 4) and `alignOffset` apply to it, the list stays inside the window with an 8 pt margin, and it never flips to the other side. Without an anchorRef, or when the ref cannot be measured, the list stays centred. `start` and `end` mean left and right (top and bottom for side left or right), with no right-to-left flipping, so `dir` is not offered. `modal={false}` draws the list in place over a live page. Checkbox items and radio groups are controlled like their web parts (`checked`, `onCheckedChange`, `value`, `onValueChange`): the menu closes on press and its rows unmount, so keep the state in the owner. Sub-menus (`open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`) open in place below their row and expose `expanded`. `inset` lines a row up with checkbox and radio rows. No native meaning, so not offered: loop (screen-reader order does not wrap) and textValue (there is no type-ahead). Radix collision props (arrowPadding, avoidCollisions, collisionBoundary, collisionPadding, sticky, hideWhenDetached, updatePositionStrategy) are not listed.

nativeOnly.name: icon
nativeOnly.reason: Native has no icon component; web uses lucide-react. Button size="icon" and every glyph-bearing component need one.
nativeOnly.note: icon takes any lucide-compatible component, so ui-native adds no icon or SVG dependency and the consumer supplies the component. size is "sm" | "md" | "lg" or a number; tone follows the Text tones. The icon is decorative (hidden from screen readers) unless label is set.

nativeOnly.name: stack
nativeOnly.reason: Native has no layout primitive for rows and columns; every screen re-implements flex rows and gaps.
nativeOnly.note: One Stack, no Box. direction is "row" | "column"; gap takes spacing tokens; align and justify map to flex alignment and wrap allows flex wrap. Renders a plain View with no accessibility role.

nativeOnly.name: spacer
nativeOnly.reason: Fixed or flexible gap between siblings when Stack gap is not enough.
nativeOnly.note: size takes a spacing token for a fixed gap; the flex prop makes it absorb free space instead.

foundationNotes: Tabular data in 0.1.0: `data-list` and `item` rows cover it, so `table` is later 0.2.0 and not a foundation component.
Typography in 0.1.0: `text`, `heading` and `label` cover it; the `typography` extras (Blockquote, InlineCode, List) are later 0.2.0.
